declaration.preface:
To support and align with the people-centric vision, workforce commitments, and strategic objectives of the Anthea Group, DRT-Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. has established this Responsible Workforce Management Framework as a comprehensive approach for managing its workforce responsibilities across all business operations. The Framework is designed to foster a safe, inclusive, respectful, and engaging workplace while promoting employee well-being, fair labour practices, diversity, equal opportunity, capability development, and compliance with applicable labour laws and international standards.

To facilitate the effective implementation of this Framework, the Company has also developed an internal Responsible Workforce Management Roadmap, which translates the Group's workforce priorities into site-specific objectives, targets, action plans, and performance monitoring mechanisms. This Roadmap supports the continuous enhancement of workforce management practices, employee engagement, occupational health and safety, talent development, and organizational culture, while reinforcing the Company's commitment to responsible and sustainable business operations.

DRT – Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. is committed to fostering a workplace where human rights are respected, employees are treated with dignity and fairness, and everyone has the opportunity to work in a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment. As a manufacturer of specialty aroma chemicals, the Company recognizes that protecting labor and human rights is fundamental to sustainable business growth, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and long-term value creation for employees, customers, business partners, and other stakeholders.

This Responsible Workforce Management Framework establishes the Company's commitment to upholding internationally recognized human rights principles and complying with all applicable labor laws and regulations across its manufacturing facilities located at Unit I and Unit II in Roha, Raigad, Maharashtra. The policy provides a comprehensive framework for promoting occupational health and safety, preventing discrimination and harassment, ensuring fair working conditions, supporting employee learning and career development, prohibiting child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking, and fostering open social dialogue and employee engagement. Through this policy, DRT–Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. aims to cultivate a respectful, ethical, and responsible workplace culture while driving continual improvement in labor and human rights performance across its operations and business relationships.
declaration.declaration:
The objective of this Responsible Workforce Management Frameworkis to establish a comprehensive framework for promoting and protecting labor and human rights across the operations of DRT – Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. and to foster a safe, inclusive, ethical, and respectful workplace for all employees and workers associated with the Company.

Ensure compliance with all applicable labor laws, employment regulations, human rights principles, and other statutory requirements.

Protect the health, safety, and wellbeing of employees by maintaining a safe and healthy working environment and preventing occupational injuries and illnesses.

Promote equal employment opportunities and maintain a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, bullying, retaliation, and any form of unfair treatment.

Provide fair and lawful working conditions, including equitable wages, working hours, employee benefits, leave entitlements, welfare facilities, and respectful treatment in accordance with applicable legal requirements.

Support employee growth through continuous learning, competency development, performance management, and equal access to career development opportunities.

Prohibit all forms of child labor, forced labor, bonded labor, compulsory labor, human trafficking, and any other form of modern slavery throughout the Company's operations and, where applicable, within its supply chain.

Respect employees' rights to freedom of association, collective bargaining where legally applicable, and constructive social dialogue while encouraging open communication and employee participation.

Provide accessible, confidential, and transparent grievance mechanisms that enable employees to raise concerns without fear of retaliation and ensure timely investigation and resolution.
declaration.scope:
This Responsible Workforce Management Frameworkapplies to all business activities and employment practices of DRT–Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. The policy is applicable to all permanent employees, temporary employees, contract workers, trainees, apprentices, interns, consultants, and other personnel working on behalf of the Company. The Company also expects contractors, suppliers, service providers, and business partners to uphold the principles set forth in this policy and to conduct their operations in a manner consistent with applicable labor laws, human rights standards, and ethical business practices.

This policy encompasses all employment-related activities, including recruitment and hiring, onboarding, working conditions, occupational health and safety, wages and benefits, working hours, employee welfare, performance management, learning and development, career advancement, equal opportunity, diversity and inclusion, prevention of discrimination and harassment, grievance management, social dialogue, and the prevention of child labor, forced labor, bonded labor, human trafficking, and other forms of modern slavery across the Company's operations and, where applicable, within its supply chain.

focusAreas: Child Labor, Forced Labor, and Human Trafficking

Occupational Health and Safety: Promote a safe, healthy, and secure working environment by preventing occupational injuries and illnesses, identifying and mitigating workplace hazards, ensuring emergency preparedness, and fostering a proactive safety culture through employee participation, training, and continual improvement.
Discrimination and Harassment: Maintain a workplace that is free from discrimination, harassment, bullying, retaliation, and any form of inappropriate behavior by promoting equal opportunity, diversity, inclusion, dignity, respect, and fair treatment for all employees.
Workplace Practices: Provide fair, safe, and lawful working conditions by ensuring compliance with applicable labor laws relating to working hours, wages, benefits, leave, welfare facilities, employment practices, and workplace wellbeing while promoting work-life balance.
Skill & Career Management and Training: Support employee growth and long-term career development through fair performance management, competency development, equal access to learning opportunities, leadership development, succession planning, and continuous professional training.
Child Labor, Forced Labor, and Human Tra: Maintain zero tolerance for child labor, forced labor, bonded labor, compulsory labor, prison labor, debt bondage, human trafficking, and any other form of modern slavery throughout the Company's operations and, where applicable, its supply chain.
Social Dialogue: Promote open, transparent, and constructive communication between management and employees by respecting freedom of association, enabling employee participation, encouraging consultation, supporting grievance mechanisms, and maintaining positive industrial relations.
Employee Wellbeing and Welfare: Promote the physical, mental, and social wellbeing of employees by providing appropriate welfare facilities, supporting work-life balance, encouraging wellness initiatives, and fostering a healthy, respectful, and engaging work environment that enhances employee satisfaction and productivity.
Grievance Mechanism and Ethical Workplac: Maintain accessible, confidential, and transparent grievance mechanisms that enable employees and workers to raise concerns without fear of retaliation. Promote ethical conduct, accountability, fair investigation of complaints, and timely resolution of workplace issues while strengthening trust and integrity across the organization.

policy.monitoring:
DRT – Anthea Aroma Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. shall establish and maintain a systematic process for monitoring, recording, and reporting its labor and human rights performance across Unit I and Unit II. Reporting shall include key performance indicators such as occupational health and safety performance, employee training and competency development, working conditions, employee wellbeing, discrimination and harassment cases, grievances, employee engagement, compliance with applicable labor laws, and the prevention of child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking.

The Human Resources (HR) Department, in coordination with the Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Department and other relevant functions, shall periodically review labor and human rights performance and report progress against the Company's objectives, commitments, and targets to the Management. Relevant records shall be maintained to demonstrate legal compliance, support customer and stakeholder requirements, facilitate internal audits and management reviews, and drive the continual improvement of the Company's labor and human rights management practices.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This Responsible Workforce Management Framework shall be reviewed at least once every year, or earlier if required due to changes in applicable labor laws, human rights standards, regulatory requirements, business operations, organizational structure, stakeholder expectations, or emerging labor and human rights risks. The review shall ensure that the policy remains relevant, effective, and aligned with the Company's strategic objectives, sustainability commitments, and internationally recognized labor and human rights principles.

The review shall be coordinated by the Human Resources (HR) Department in consultation with the Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Department and approved by the Management. Any revisions arising from the review shall be communicated to all relevant employees and stakeholders, and appropriate actions shall be implemented to support the continual improvement of the Company's labor and human rights management practices.
